"Spoonman" is a song by the American rock band Soundgarden. Written by frontman Chris Cornell, "Spoonman" was released on February 15, 1994 as the first single from the band's fourth studio album, Superunknown (1994). "Spoonman" is often credited as one of the songs that launched Soundgarden's career into the mainstream. The song peaked at number three on the Billboard Mainstream Rock Tracks chart and number nine on the Modern Rock Tracks chart. A remixed version of the song by Steve Fisk appears on the "Black Hole Sun" and "My Wave" singles. The song was included on Soundgarden's 1997 greatest hits album, A-Sides and the 2010 compilation album Telephantasm.

I'm personally not a fan of the polarized political climate we find ourselves in. This whole us vs them mindset is detrimental to just about everything.

That being said here's a quick run down:

1.) Military

I think America's industrial complex leads a wide open door for it to be abused. We having the people in charge of making decisions to send troops or drones or what have you, while they benefit from the money spent on these actions. I think that the US has chosen its position as a sort of work police. Which has put us in a weird spot that if we take actions against a "bad guy" then we're going too far. However if we don't, many controes condone our lack of help. I believe our military is important and vital, but over decades has become bloated with many unneeded redundancies. I believe the people should have more of a say when it comes to military actions. The budget can definitely use some trimmings there, were so far ahead of everyone else when it comes to military spending that it's ludicrous.

2.) current election

What a God damn clusterfuck. Each cycle I've witnessed has become progressively worse than the previous. With this one reaching the pinnacle of absurdity.

I think Hilary is a crook and a career politician, willing to lie and cheat to achieve her goals. I simply don't trust what she hides behind the curtain.

Trump is not a politician, he a media darling. He knows what buttons to press to achieve the reaction he wants. In my opinion he is human click bait. He's not a career politician which gives some hope. But I also haven't seen a lot of evidence that he actually grasps the concept of what being president actually requires. He's also shiesty and underhanded and I'm terrified to have him front and center on the world stage.

Sanders, well, he's just the least smelliest turd in the toilet. He has some nice rhetoric, but being a realist I realize that many of them are empty promises. Wonderful ideas that would only be implemented in an ideal AlterNet reality. However he has some core beliefs that I can definitely get behind.

3.) General goverment

I think they are needed in our society. In small groups of people it's not a necessity since they can self regulate. But for an entire nation to opperate without chaos, there needs to be some guiding.

There's certain agencies that are very important at their foundation (like the EPA for example) but have morphed into this monolithic bureaucratic cess pool of wasted time, effort and money. Other agencies could be scrapped all together with little to no impact on society.

I think more money should be funneled into "socialist" programs that benefit the people themselves.

4.) civil liberties

This is a big one but I'll do my best to TLDR my thoughts. I believe that every presidential cabinet has slowly cranked the wheel another knotch. No one is ever going to turn the wheel back, so it just keeps going forward and every ten years you can look back at what's been lost.

I think the NSA need to be monitored by an impartial third party, as they have become far too powerful and intrusive. You should be allowed to use the internet without fear of stumbling up on something that might get you "flagged".

I think we should have the right to bare arms, but I do believe in background checks to get a weapon. There's very rarely a need to have a gun in your hands within two days. I believe CC should be a right, but perhaps more education should be required to obtain that license. I believe weapons should be allowed up to a certain point. There's no need for full auto weapons in civilians hands. Even 30 round clips are unnecessary. I don't support those morons who have no knowledge of weaponry making laws against them. I believe we've lost too many liberties in the last 15 years.

5.) foreign policy

Isolationism doesn't work, not in this day and age, and not in the current situation that America has put itself in. I think we do need to intervene in certain humanitarian crises and when genocides occur. However out interference with civil wars is far too overbearing. The CIA in particular has been doing some seriously shady shit for a long time now. We need to stop looking at situations and figuring out what we have to gain, and look at them and figure out what we can do to help.

As far as aggressive foreign powers, that's a bit trickier. We need to keep discussion open. If we simply keep talking and working (albeit slowly) towards a goal of peace. It would go a lot further than the saber rattling that were so fond of.

6.) education

Is a must, a country with a higher level of learning has innumerable benefits over one with a high level of illiteracy. I believe college should be available to anyone who chooses to go. I believe this current student loan crises is artificial and only benefits those who reap in the money, while impoverishing those who are just trying to better their lives. This is disgusting. A functional degree (I'm excluding shit like "interpretive feminine dance studies) should not put you into a life time of debt. It discourages people from pursuing higher education and adds to the growing pool of uneducated adults damned to live their life doing low paying menial jobs.

Well, there's a convoluted rant concerning some of my political beliefs. You can draw your own conclusions. But I'd say that I lean towards the left while still holding onto some random conservative views. Also keep in mind this was a TLDR I threw together while waiting on the bus.
